data: The reusable workhorse — nine lift Falcon 9, flown and re-flown dozens of times
Nine engines, one booster, flown and re-flown dozens of times

SpaceX's Merlin 1D is the engine that made the reusable Falcon 9 possible. Nine of them cluster on Falcon 9's first stage, running a gas-generator cycle on LOX and RP-1, with the center engine also used for entry and landing burns. First flown in September 2013, the Merlin 1D matured into a high-cadence workhorse: individual engines have accumulated more than twenty flights apiece, a reuse record that changed what the industry believed was economically achievable. The vacuum variant, Merlin 1D Vacuum, powers Falcon 9's upper stage with a larger nozzle optimised for the near-vacuum environment.
